thread:
Sarah L: kicking off the region account + network runup for eu-north-2 — aiming for GPU fleet soft-launch next week. tagging @Mike T for quotas and @Alex R for networking.
Mike T: got it. I'll start quota requests today. which GPU type are we requesting? A100/80GB or A10G?
Sarah L: primary target A100-80GB for training-like infra, fallback A10G for cheaper dev runs. we'll request both but prefer A100 capacity in reserved pool.
Alex R: networking notes — low-latency peering with our eu-central-prod is mandatory. plan: new Shared VPC project + two subnets (private east/west) + dedicated NAT per subnet.
Jenny C: authorization checklist: service accounts + workload identity, KMS key for CEK, org policy to prevent external IPs by default. I'll prepare IAM bindings.
Mike T: quota requests queued: compute.googleapis.com GPUs: +40 A100, +80 A10G; CPUs: +200 vCPUs; regional persistent disk IOPS bumped. Put the ticket link?
Sarah L: https://ticketing.internal/INC-4521 — put the quota request IDs in the ticket. Also add a cost estimate line: expected baseline $18k/mo if A100 reserved, else $7k/mo for A10 fallback.
Alex R: network security: firewall allow list only for infra LB CIDRs, bastion in mgmt project, private GKE nodes with no external IP, VPC-SC? not required but document the data egress path.
Jenny C: adding: enable VPC Flow Logs on both subnets for 30 days retention, export to logging-gcs/bucket eu-north-2-logs. confirm retention & permissions.
infra-bot: provisioning: project creation started for redwood-eun2-core at 1823409450. status: project created, org policy baseline applied.
Mike T: received project id redwood-eun2-core. starting service activation: compute.googleapis.com, iamcredentials.googleapis.com, cloudkms.googleapis.com.
Sarah L: quick win: add this terraform snippet to the infra repo to create the shared VPC host project (we'll finalize names in PR):
```
resource "google_project_service" "compute" {
  project = var.project
  service = "compute.googleapis.com"
}
resource "google_compute_network" "shared" {
  name                    = "redwood-shared-net"
  project                 = var.project
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}
```
Alex R: routing: we'll use custom subnet ranges 10.40.0.0/16 (west) and 10.41.0.0/16 (east). Reserve /28 for peering gateways. Documented in the runbook.
Jenny C: KMS: create key ring in eu-north-2, IAM: cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -> service-account@redwood-eun2-core. Add rotation: 90 days.
Mike T: GPU quota followup: file shows A100 quota pending approval, ETA 48h. I added a fallback plan to spin A10Gs if A100 not granted by T+3 days.
Sarah L: validation checklist before handoff to platform-oncall:
- project created + org baseline ✅
- shared VPC created + subnets ✅
- firewall rules scoped ✅
- KMS key + SA ✅
- quotas requested & ticket linked (pending) ✅
- image build pipeline hooked to private registry (set) -> TODO: confirm
- test node pool with A10G spun and smoke tests passed -> TODO
Alex R: I'll run connectivity tests once peering is up. sample command: `gcloud compute networks peerings list --project=redwood-eun2-core` and `nc -vz 10.41.1.5 9090` for service hit tests.
Jenny C: tagging & cost center: apply labels `team=infra,env=prod,region=eu-north-2,cost_center=platform` to all resources. I'll add script to enforce labels via org policy.
infra-bot: build: image-pipeline triggered for eu-north-2 at 1823410520. status: build started.
Sarah L: owners for handoff: oncall rotation will be @Alex R (network), @Jenny C (security/iam), @Mike T (capacity). I'll post the runbook PR once image pipeline green.
Mike T: note on limits: some zones in eu-north-2 have soft GPU caps; we'll plan cross-zone spread to avoid single-zone capacity constraints.
Alex R: scheduling: aiming for soft-launch (internal routing only) Thu 09:00 UTC. Is that still good for everyone?
Jenny C: yes, will be available for handoff checks. I'll monitor Flow Logs and IAM changes.
Sarah L: great — I'll update the ticket with the runup checklist and assign the PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
